**P2 — Make durable starts idempotent across CLI retries**

`aws()` permits two attempts, but this invocation supplies no `DurableExecutionName`. If Lambda accepts the request before a transient response failure causes a retry, one marker can start multiple executions; marker-based evidence is then merged while cleanup tracks only one returned ARN. Pass a deterministic name such as `<runId>-<marker>` via `--durable-execution-name` and verify it in the CLI contract test.
